verse: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
story: Israel's vine lies trampled and torn, and the people have only one prayer left.

Three times this psalm repeats a single plea: restore us, cause Your face to shine. The people do not ask for stronger walls or a better army. They ask for God's face, because if He looks upon them in favour, they are saved. The psalm points on to the Son of Man at God's right hand, upon whom restoration finally rests. Salvation is not a thing we manage; it is a face turned toward us.
When you cannot fix what is broken, pray the simplest prayer. Ask Him to look on you and shine.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
